main_text.l: sem acerrime oppugnasse. Hac inquam, vt alia
omittam, & tu partim non ignoras, & Iesuitae, vt dixi,
negare non audebunt, & ipsa à ficto[?] potuisse in reli-
gione animo proficisci, neminem arbitror, nisi omnis
Quod denique, ad ipsum hunc libellum, seu
Colloquium hoc attinet, in eo brevitatis causa imitatus
Platonem, & M. Tullium in suis de Philosophia
libris, te, cum aliqua tui laude (quam aequo, quaso[?],
animo feras: cum nec me blandiri, nec te laudibus
capi posse optime noveris) induco Doctorem, de So-
cietate Iesv, deque ipsius idolis differentem: me
autem discipulum vel addubitantem, vel quaeren-
tem aliquid, tandemque sententiam meam tuæ

page.notes: The "5" in the date "1579" has an unusual form and is read as 5. "quaso" is read with a doubtful "s" in the scan. "ficto" is printed with a ligature (ct) that is hard to read; the reading "ficto" is uncertain. The running head is spaced out in print as "I E S V I T I C V M". The catchword area is empty.
